legal.description: Solune legal information: terms of use, privacy and consent management.
legal.pendingNotice: Owner information is incomplete. The fields identified below must be completed before publishing this website as a commercial activity.
legal.identityText: Solune is the trading name used to present the design, development and website maintenance services on this site. Available details and fields awaiting completion are listed below.
legal.contract.title: Information and contracts
legal.contract.text: This website presents our services and lets you request information or a proposal. An enquiry is not a contract and creates no payment obligation. Each project is defined in a proposal covering scope, deliverables, price, schedule and terms. Maintenance is an additional, optional service. Extensions and external provider costs are set out in the relevant proposal.
legal.use.title: Using the website
legal.use.text: You can browse without creating an account. Use the contact channels for service-related enquiries and share only information you are entitled to communicate. Interfering with security or availability, attempting unauthorised access, or sending unlawful or abusive communications is not permitted.
legal.rights.title: Content and intellectual property
legal.rights.text: Text, designs, brands, code and images remain subject to their owners’ rights and applicable licences. Reference photographs are served locally; sources and licences are documented in the project. Browsing grants no exploitation rights. NOVA DENTAL and ÉTER are concept projects, not evidence of real clients, commercial results or bookings. Licensing or assignment terms for commissioned projects are defined in their proposals.
legal.availability.title: Availability and external links
legal.availability.text: We aim to keep information current and the website available. Maintenance, technical incidents or external causes may lead to interruptions. External links lead to third-party services with their own terms and policies.
legal.law.title: Applicable law and enquiries
legal.law.text: Applicable Spanish and European law will govern. Enquiries can be sent to the contact listed here. Disputes will be handled under the applicable law and jurisdiction rules, respecting consumer rights where relevant.
legal.overview.title: General information
legal.overview.text: This policy explains information supplied when contacting Solune, technical data needed to use the website, and storage preferences. It reflects the features currently implemented and does not attribute processing to services that are not integrated.
legal.demoForm: Sending is disabled until the endpoint and public Turnstile key are configured. No simulated success is shown. Fields remain in memory and are lost when you leave the page.
legal.liveForm: The form sends the listed fields and a Turnstile token by POST to a Cloudflare Worker. The server validates the data and verification before forwarding the enquiry to hola@solune.dev through Resend. We do not store the contents in cookies or localStorage.
legal.information.title: Information processed
legal.information.text: Name, email, company or project, and message are required; phone number is optional. Confirmation that you have read this policy is also required. The form does not request a budget, service, current website or documents. We may receive information voluntarily sent by email. Hosting infrastructure may process IP addresses, browser details and HTTP requests to deliver the website and investigate incidents; its provider and retention must be confirmed by the owner. Do not send passwords, identity documents, medical information or other sensitive data.
legal.purpose.title: Enquiries and proposals
legal.purpose.text: When an actual enquiry arrives by email or a connected form, data is used to respond, understand the request and prepare the requested proposal. The legal basis is taking precontractual steps at your request or performing a contract where applicable (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)); general enquiries rely on the legitimate interest in handling relevant business communications (Art. 6(1)(f)), subject to your rights. Reading or accepting this policy does not authorise advertising or subscriptions.
legal.security.title: Security and abuse prevention
legal.security.text: When enabled, the form uses Cloudflare Turnstile and server validation to prevent abuse. Turnstile processes technical browser and connection information; the Worker may send the IP to Siteverify to verify the token. The token is temporary and single-use. Protection does not depend on accepting analytics or preferences. Application logs do not record form fields. Absolute security cannot be guaranteed.
legal.sources.title: Enquiry sources
legal.sources.text: The application neither stores UTM parameters nor attaches them to enquiries. It creates no persistent identifiers to attribute contacts to campaigns. Language links may contain the lang parameter, which selects a language and is not a personal identifier.
legal.preferenceText: Your decision is stored in this browser for 180 days using localStorage. Change it in Cookie settings. Rejecting or withdrawing preferences deletes the saved language without preventing language changes during your visit. Analytics requires separate permission and is off by default. If browser storage is blocked, the decision is kept in memory only during the visit.
legal.analyticsOff: Google Analytics 4 is prepared in the code but is not configured or active. This version neither downloads Google scripts nor sends statistics. If configured, it will require explicit analytics consent and the relevant information will appear in the settings panel and cookie policy.
legal.analyticsActive: Google Analytics 4, provided by Google Ireland Limited, loads only after you accept analytics. General browsing statistics rely on your consent (GDPR Art. 6(1)(a)), which you may withdraw at any time.
legal.analyticsDetails: It may process technical device and connection information, visited pages and pseudonymous analytics identifiers. This integration sends only known page routes, with no URL queries, fragments or form content; it does not send detailed referral information. It does not use Google Signals, advertising personalisation, remarketing or Google Ads features. Enhanced measurement and advertising links must be disabled in the Analytics property. Withdrawal stops new events and removes accessible first-party analytics cookies.
legal.retention.title: Retention
legal.retention.text: Fields remain in memory while you complete the form and are cleared when sending is confirmed. Enquiries received by email are retained as needed to respond and manage a potential business relationship and, where applicable, for legal duties or claims. The owner must specify mailbox and provider retention periods. The application does not store the Turnstile token. Local consent and preferences expire after 180 days.
legal.providers.title: Service providers
legal.providers.text: Fonts and photos are served as local files. Cloudflare hosts the website and API with Workers and provides Turnstile. Resend sends enquiries by email. The receiving mailbox provider still needs to be identified. Google Analytics is used only when configured and you accept analytics. If you choose to book a meeting, the embedded Cal.com calendar handles the booking. It only loads when you select “Choose a date and time”.
legal.international.title: International processing
legal.international.text: Enabled Cloudflare services and, if configured and accepted, Google Analytics may process data through international infrastructure. Consult each provider’s safeguards and data processing terms. The owner must complete account-specific and provider information before publishing.
legal.dataRights.title: Your rights
legal.dataRights.text: You may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability where applicable, and withdraw consent without affecting earlier lawful processing. Contact the privacy address and explain which right you wish to exercise. We do not request identity-document copies in advance; proportionate information would be requested only if needed to verify identity. You may complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency if you believe your rights have been infringed.
legal.definition.title: Cookies and local storage
legal.definition.text: Cookies are small files a browser can store and send to a website on later visits. localStorage keeps information on the device but does not automatically send it with each request. This policy covers both. We request your choice before enabling optional services; browsing, scrolling or closing settings is not acceptance.
legal.storageConsent: We store only the consent record: selected categories, version, saving date and expiry date. It contains no advertising identifier.
legal.storageLanguage: Language is saved only with Preferences permission. Otherwise it works in memory and through the lang URL parameter. The key has no native expiry: the application removes it when permission is withdrawn or the 180-day consent expires.
legal.storageAnalytics: With consent, Google Analytics may create the cookies determined by the configured measurement ID. This integration limits their duration to 180 days without automatic renewal. No advertising storage is used.
legal.storageDuration: Up to 180 days; optional storage is removed earlier on withdrawal.
legal.column.name: Name
legal.table.necessary: Remember the decision and its expiry.
legal.table.preferences: Remember ES / EN in this browser.
legal.change.title: Change or withdraw your choice
legal.change.text: Use Cookie settings in the footer or the button on this page. Accept, reject or save categories separately. Withdrawing preferences removes the language key. Withdrawing analytics stops measurement, deletes accessible first-party cookies and reloads the page if the script was loaded, discarding its in-memory processes. You can also clear storage through your browser. Deleting the decision makes us ask again; it does not reactivate optional services.
legal.consentDuration: 180 days from the latest decision; removed when the application detects its expiry.
